‘NO’ TO WPS HARASSMENT

Members of theFilipinos Do Not Yield (FDNY) Movement  and allied groups stage a lightning protest in front of the Chinese Embassy along Sen. Gil Puyat Avenue in Makati City on May 11 to condemn the continued harassment and aggressive presence of Chinese ships in the West Philippine Sea. 

📸: Norman Cruz
